findings.summary: Theme is hard-coded dark rather than preference-aware
findings.evidence: Computed CSS contained no prefers-color-scheme/color-scheme handling; light-preference and default screenshots were pixel-identical, leaving the interface hard-coded dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide light/dark tokens selected with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes do not preserve visual continuity
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition rules and page navigation uses full-document abrupt swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The long feed offers no scroll-state orientation
findings.evidence: The 4,918px mobile explore feed has static chrome and no progress/scroll-state treatment; CSS inspection found no scroll timeline or scroll-state implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll progress/orientation affordance that respects reduced motion.

findings.evidence: Rendered DOM contains three Bootstrap-style .modal elements and two custom dropdown-menu lists, but zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate modal flows to dialog and transient menus to popover with declarative light dismiss.

findings.summary: Reusable feed cards are not container-responsive
findings.evidence: Reusable feed cards adapt only through global layout CSS; CSS inspection found no container queries or container-type declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Give card containers container-type and move card breakpoints to @container where cards appear in different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on primary controls
findings.evidence: Programmatically focusing the first ten visible links/buttons produced outline: none 0px and no box-shadow on every sampled control.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible outline that is not removed by component styles.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse mobile throttling measured LCP 5,634ms (poor), despite a fast unthrottled trace LCP of 1,338ms; CLS remained 0.001 and TBT 10ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the first visible thumbnail/LCP resource, reduce load delay, and remeasure under mobile throttling.

findings.evidence: HAR found five first-party CSS/JS parser-inserted high/very-high-priority candidates plus third-party scripts; Lighthouse reported an LCP discovery failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical classic scripts, inline only critical CSS, and give the LCP image explicit priority.

findings.summary: Analytics and ad code dominate JavaScript bytes
findings.evidence: Scripts transfer 289,681 bytes; Google Tag Manager alone is 153,386 bytes and ad-provider plus ad SDK add 76,600 bytes, a disproportionate non-core share.
findings.suggestedFix: Load analytics/ad dependencies conditionally after consent or interaction and remove unused library code.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found two images in the landing disclaimer without alt attributes: the background and logo.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the logo a meaningful alt and mark the decorative background alt="".

findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a deprecated unload listener in libraries.js and four BFCache failure reasons, including that unload handler.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload handling with pagehide/visibilitychange where necessary and remove avoidable no-store constraints.

findings.summary: Indexing signals contain sitemap and hreflang defects
findings.evidence: Pages return 200 with canonical/hreflang and robots allows indexing, but /sitemap.xml returns 404 and the Swedish hreflang is incorrectly declared as se rather than sv.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap (or reference the intended sitemap) and change Swedish hreflang from se to sv.

findings.summary: Album share metadata is internally inconsistent
findings.evidence: The album has Open Graph/Twitter tags but no JSON-LD, and og:url is http:// while its canonical and served URL are https://.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the HTTPS canonical in og:url and add accurate schema.org ImageObject/CreativeWork JSON-LD.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced security headers are largely absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Tracking and ad-tech footprint is excessive by default
findings.evidence: The load contacts 33 third-party origins, including Google Analytics and two ad-tech hosts; GA cookies are non-Secure, SameSite=None, and persist for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics/ad requests behind informed consent, reduce vendors, and set analytics cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite policy and shorter retention.

findings.evidence: Authentication exposes Google, Reddit, Twitter and email routes, but no passkey/WebAuthn affordance was present in the audited sign-in entry surface. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey/WebAuthn registration and sign-in alongside federated and email methods.

findings.evidence: html lang=pt and hreflang variants exist, but CSS inspection found no logical inline/block properties and the Swedish alternate uses invalid hreflang se.
findings.suggestedFix: Use logical CSS properties and correct Swedish hreflang to sv; verify an RTL locale in layout tests.

findings.summary: Feed images miss modern delivery features
findings.evidence: Images audit found 38 legacy-format images, 22 without srcset, and 15 without explicit dimensions; no AVIF/WebP images were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add responsive srcset/sizes, and reserve dimensions for every avatar/thumbnail.

findings.evidence: HAR transferred 752,432 bytes across 55 requests; third-party analytics/ad scripts account for at least 229,986 script bytes before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte budget and defer or remove analytics/ad scripts that do not serve the immediate task.
